n0bed5d17ea.headline: Japan PM Fumio Kishida to announce USD 42 bln investment plan in India over five years: Report
n0bed5d17ea.summary: Japanese Prime Minister Fumio Kishida is reportedly set to announce a plan to invest $42 billion (5 trillion yen) in India over five years during his visit. The announcement is expected during his Saturday visit to New Delhi.
n0bed5d17ea.why: Japanese investment in India covers infrastructure, manufacturing and technology, and is a key pillar of the bilateral economic relationship.

n80cd229ec1.headline: LandBank delivers P569-M fuel subsidy for PUV drivers
n80cd229ec1.summary: Jeepney drivers have claimed Pantawid Pasada cash cards loaded with a P6,500 fuel subsidy at a Land Bank of the Philippines branch in Cubao.
n80cd229ec1.why: Land Bank of the Philippines is a state-owned lender, and fuel subsidy programmes cushion transport costs for the public-transport sector.

nd41733bd01.headline: New procedure for operations with tenge introduced for banks in Kyrgyzstan
nd41733bd01.summary: A temporary procedure for operations with the Kazakh tenge has been introduced for commercial banks, exchange offices, and microfinance and microcredit companies in Kyrgyzstan.
nd41733bd01.why: Currency operation rules set by regulators determine how banks and exchange offices handle foreign currency, affecting liquidity and cross-border payments.
